notes.apiEquivalent: API-equivalent cost is an estimate at published pay-as-you-go prices. It is not money charged and does not measure how much of a subscription allowance was used.
notes.attribution: Person = the responsible user recorded on each run (who woke or requested the work, or the task's responsible person). Work Paperclip assigned to the company's default person, or scheduled runs with nobody behind them, are shown as Automatic.
notes.tokens: Total tokens = input + cache reads + output; cache writes are part of input, so nothing is counted twice.
